# emojify extension

Copilot Extension that registers one tool:

- `emojify_markdown_list` - emojifies markdown bullet/numbered lists using Copilot SDK and returns usage metrics (AI credits, input tokens, output tokens). It can also copy the transformed markdown to clipboard.

## Notes

- Entry point: `extension.mjs`
- This extension is intended for project discovery from `.github\extensions\emojify`.
